body.title: Define strict dev source, preparation and receipt metadata
body.summary: Add the approved source-offer, checkpoint/result/cancel and dev receipt types/parsers in the proposed dev modules. Reuse S1 canonical hashing, bounds, path and target/runtime validators; keep public wire records and current bundle consumers compiling until the coordinated integration task.
acceptanceChecks: Validate unknown fields, versions, IDs, source/ref forms, target/runtime/recipe, portable checkout/stage paths, nonce/run identity and record-size bounds; preserve shared Windows drive canonicalization.

Compute the approved noncircular source digest/prospective release ID separately from final receipt/inventory digests; define full PreparedCandidate reconstruction and reject same-ID/different-source or mixed receipt modes.
Validate commit-bound optional package.json insrcInstaller hook references in order, without executing hooks or importing application services.
Do not switch existing PreparedReleaseOffer consumers to a partially wired union or alter public Delivery/Installation/ReleaseManifest/ManagerRequest/UpgradeOffer/Phase schemas.
